_what: How separately recorded tracks of one recording (screen, camera, microphone, system sound) are checked to be in step (track-alignment.mjs). Each track says when, on the wall clock, its first sample was captured, and the first timestamp its own file starts at; a track whose file starts later or earlier than its wall clock says it should is out of step by that much. `tolerance_ms` is how far out a track may be and still count as in step; `seek_fractions` are the points of the recording (0 to 1) at which a probe also seeks each track and times how long the first sample takes. Words are for the person.

words.in_step: All {count} tracks are in step (the furthest apart is {skew_ms} ms).
words.out_of_step: {track} is {offset_ms} ms {direction} the others; the furthest apart are {skew_ms} ms and {tolerance_ms} ms is allowed.
words.one_track: There is only one track, so there is nothing to line up.
words.unreadable: {track} could not be read, so its place against the others is not known.
